kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتغرغر (form IIq)
# نَتَغَرْغَرُ (nataḡarḡaru) /na.ta.ɣar.ɣa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَغَرْغَرَ (taḡarḡara)
# نَتَغَرْغَرَ (nataḡarḡara) /na.ta.ɣar.ɣa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَغَرْغَرَ (taḡarḡara)
# نَتَغَرْغَرْ (nataḡarḡar) /na.ta.ɣar.ɣar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَغَرْغَرَ (taḡarḡara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
